description: Replays each recovered conversation turn as one cache request through libCacheSim, sweeping 9 eviction algorithms x 10 cache sizes x 2 workloads. Produces the miss-ratio / byte-miss-ratio numbers in data/caching/results.txt.

trace_format.order: started_at ascending; ties broken by (session_id, turn_id)
trace_format.obj_id: first 8 bytes of md5(session_id) as uint64; collisions are checked and abort the build
trace_format.obj_size: it (the turn's input tokens); 1 token = 1 byte
trace_format.obj_size_note: NOT it+ot: the swept cache sizes are exactly {1e-5..1e-2} x sum(first-turn it) under obj_size = it (ratio 1.0000 for both workloads, 0.94 under it+ot). Object size grows turn over turn because each input carries the accumulated context.
trace_format.next_access_vtime: 1-BASED request index of the session's next turn, -1 on the last access
trace_format.next_access_vtime_note: Must be 1-based; a 0-based trace makes cachesim's oracle evictor recurse forever on back-to-back accesses.

sweep.cache_size_note: cachesim resolves fractions against the trace's byte working-set size (sum of first-seen object sizes).

libcachesim.note: Pinned: the patch in pipeline/caching/patches/ applies to exactly this commit.

cmake_flag_notes.OPT_SUPPORT_ZSTD_TRACE: traces are uncompressed; avoids a hard zstd header dependency
cmake_flag_notes.isystem: upstream commented out include_directories(${LIGHTGBM_PATH}), so LightGBM headers must be injected via compiler flags
cmake_flag_notes.UPDATE_OBJ_SIZE_ON_HIT: activates the KV-cache patch; MUST be set in BOTH CMAKE_C_FLAGS and CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS, or the C++ policies silently revert to vanilla semantics

figures.metric: token hit ratio = 1 - byte miss ratio, vs cache size in tokens
figures.note: All nine algorithms are swept into results.txt; the paper plots seven.
figures.filename_note: Output stems are the paper's \includegraphics names verbatim.
